name: Well Adjusted Chiropractic
description: Agent skills for booking, locations and services at Well Adjusted Chiropractic clinics in Colorado and Texas.

skills.name: book-appointment
skills.description: Help a user book a chiropractic, massage or shockwave appointment at a Well Adjusted Chiropractic clinic.

skills.name: find-location
skills.description: Find the nearest Well Adjusted Chiropractic clinic with address, phone number and office hours.

skills.name: explain-services
skills.description: Explain the services offered by Well Adjusted Chiropractic and point to the right service page.
